excerpt.zh:
[lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]出现了一艘废弃舰船。[This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。

我们推断这艘舰船之所以在该恒星系中漂泊了前年直至现在才因为恒星能发电装置故障才显形。船上没有任何生命迹象，而我们也开始了对舰船的小心拆解，希望能从中尽可能学到东西。
texts.en:
A derelict ship has appeared in [lucky_wreckage_system.GetName]. [This.GetQuantumParticleStreamDiscoveredExtra]

We have deduced that the ship remained undetected in this system for millennia, only revealing itself after its solar energy generator malfunctioned. No life signs are onboard, and we have already begun careful disassembly of the vessel to learn as much as we can.
